candidate.answerReason: B is four-fifths of the way from A to D, while C is nine-tenths of the way. Their separation is one-tenth of AD.

methods.label: Express both positions as fractions of the whole
methods.explanation:
Use \(AD\) as the common whole. Let \(L=AD>0\). Since \(AB:BD=4:1\) and \(AB+BD=L\), the segment \(AD\) consists of five equal shares, four of which form \(AB\). Thus
\[
AB=\frac45L.
\]
Similarly, \(AC:CD=9:1\), so
\[
AC=\frac9{10}L.
\]
Because \(\frac45=\frac8{10}<\frac9{10}\), point \(B\) lies between \(A\) and \(C\). Therefore
\[
BC=AC-AB
=\left(\frac9{10}-\frac8{10}\right)L
=\frac1{10}L.
\]
Hence \(BC\) is \(\boxed{\frac1{10}}\) of \(AD\), choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
